commandHelp.sessions:
Usage: {cli} sessions send TARGET 'one line' [--fyi] [--source-key K]   message another session
       {cli} sessions ack ID yes|no|eta:MIN [NOTE]   answer a handshake
       {cli} sessions confirm ID [--withdraw]        close a handshake you sent
       {cli} sessions inbox                          what other sessions sent you
       {cli} sessions may-disrupt [TARGET] [--requests ID,ID]
       {cli} sessions wait KIND ID                   wait for a session, job, reply, ask or host
Past sessions and their transcripts: {cli} recent --help
commandHelp.mandates:
Usage: {cli} mandates [--project P] [--format text|json|claude|codex|pi] [--force]
This session's startup context ({cli} context deliver for the calling tool).
commandHelp.vcs:
Usage: {cli} vcs publish [--source ID] [--sha REV] [--now]   publish checked main ({cli} publish --help)
       {cli} vcs deliver ...                                 checked-main delivery
For local inspection use git.
commandHelp.tools:
Usage: {cli} tools manifest [--surface ID|--discover WORD] [--density core|full] [--format json|inject]
       {cli} tools extensions [--check]
       {cli} tools run --label TEXT [--class light] -- COMMAND ...
commandHelp.db:
Usage: {cli} db tables|schema TABLE|count TABLE|sample TABLE [N]|query SQL [--store NAME]
Read-only Aico stores: {stores}. -t is the query text alias.
commandHelp.mockup:
Usage: {cli} mockup add FILE --project ID --title TITLE [--note TEXT] [--session ID] [--no-ask]
       {cli} mockup remove ID --project ID
FILE is HTML, SVG, PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP, PDF, Markdown (.md; a ```mermaid block draws a diagram) or Mermaid (.mmd), up to 5 MB of text or 8 MB of image or PDF. It shows in the Workbench Designs tab under its project. Adding the same title again from the same session replaces the design and the open view refreshes; Use this one answers the asking session. --no-ask adds it without a question in the owner's Needs you (for tests and plain adds); Use this one is then only kept in Aico.
commandHelp.monitor:
Usage: {cli} monitor status|system-info|connections|processes|mounts
Local /proc readings; service logs: {cli} logs UNIT.
commandHelp.aico: Usage: {cli} aico create|wait|waits|roots|root|sessions|watch|unwatch|wake|nudge|widget|placement|admin ...   agent coordination; each takes --help (e.g. {cli} aico wait --help)
